columns.name: NETWORK
columns.expr: {'North Carolina':'Carolina Cares Network','Arizona':'Desert Connect Network','New York':'Empire Community Care Network','Oregon':'Cascade Care Connect','Missouri':'Show-Me Community Network'}[r['STATE']]

columns.name: SERVICE_TYPE
columns.expr: weighted({'Food Assistance': 26, 'Housing & Shelter': 16 * ((1 + 1.6 * ramp(200)) if r['COUNTY'] == 'Maricopa' else 1) * (1.15 if d.day >= 26 or d.day <= 3 else 1), 'Utilities': 11 * (1.6 if month in (1, 2) or (month in (7, 8) and r['STATE'] == 'Arizona') else 1), 'Transportation': 10, 'Benefits Navigation': 9, 'Income Support': 7, 'Employment': 6, 'Mental & Behavioral Health': 7, 'Individual & Family Support': 4, 'Legal Assistance': 3, 'Clothing & Household Goods': 2})

columns.name: RECEIVING_ORGANIZATION_FINAL
columns.expr: 'Queen City Food Collective' if r['SERVICE_TYPE'] == 'Food Assistance' and r['COUNTY'] == 'Mecklenburg' and ramp(150) > 0 and chance(0.6) else r['RECEIVING_ORGANIZATION']

columns.name: NEW_PARTNER_EFFECT
columns.expr: 1 if r['RECEIVING_ORGANIZATION_FINAL'] == 'Queen City Food Collective' else 0

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.expr: {'Food Assistance':'Medically Tailored Meals' if chance(0.3) else 'Food Box Delivery','Housing & Shelter':'Rental Arrears Assistance' if chance(0.5) else 'Emergency Shelter Placement','Utilities':'LIHEAP Navigation','Transportation':'NEMT Rides','Benefits Navigation':'SNAP & Medicaid Enrollment','Income Support':'Emergency Cash Assistance','Employment':'Job Readiness Coaching','Mental & Behavioral Health':'Counseling Sessions','Individual & Family Support':'Family Case Management','Legal Assistance':'Eviction Defense','Clothing & Household Goods':'Household Essentials Kit'}[r['SERVICE_TYPE']]

columns.name: FUNDING_SOURCE
columns.expr: weighted({'1115 Medicaid Waiver': 45, 'Grant Funded': 30, 'Unfunded': 25}) if r['STATE'] in ('North Carolina','Arizona','Oregon') else weighted({'Grant Funded': 45, 'Unfunded': 55})

columns.name: URGENCY
columns.expr: weighted({'Routine': 70, 'Urgent': 24, 'Emergency': 6}) if r['SERVICE_TYPE'] != 'Housing & Shelter' else weighted({'Routine': 45, 'Urgent': 40, 'Emergency': 15})

columns.name: HEALTH_PLAN
columns.expr: pick(['Bluepeak Health Plan', 'Summit Community Care', 'Harborline Medicaid', 'Evergreen Health Partners']) if r['PAYER'] in ('Medicaid', 'Medicare Advantage', 'Dual Eligible') else 'None'

columns.name: DAYS_TO_ACCEPT
columns.expr: round(lognorm(1.4 * (1 + 3.2 * ramp(200) if r['SERVICE_TYPE'] == 'Housing & Shelter' and r['COUNTY'] == 'Maricopa' else 1) * (0.6 if r['URGENCY'] == 'Emergency' else 1), 0.65), 1)

columns.name: SERVICE_COST_USD
columns.expr: lognorm({'Food Assistance': 120, 'Housing & Shelter': 1450, 'Utilities': 380, 'Transportation': 55, 'Income Support': 450, 'Employment': 260, 'Mental & Behavioral Health': 180, 'Benefits Navigation': 75, 'Individual & Family Support': 140, 'Legal Assistance': 220, 'Clothing & Household Goods': 90}[r['SERVICE_TYPE']], 0.45) * (1 + 0.1 * (r['HOUSEHOLD_SIZE'] - 1))

status_rules.if: age <= 21 and chance(0.10 + (0.12 * ramp(200) if r['SERVICE_TYPE'] == 'Housing & Shelter' and r['COUNTY'] == 'Maricopa' else 0))

post.name: REFERRAL_STATUS
post.expr: ('Auto-Recalled' if age > 14 and chance(0.75) else 'Pending') if r['REFERRAL_STATUS'] == 'Pending' else r['REFERRAL_STATUS']

post.name: OUTCOME_SUCCESS_FLAG
post.expr: (1 if chance(0.88 if r['NEW_PARTNER_EFFECT'] else 0.6 if r['SERVICE_TYPE'] == 'Food Assistance' else 0.7) else 0) if r['REFERRAL_STATUS'].startswith('Closed') else 0

post.name: REFERRAL_STATUS
post.expr: ('Closed - Resolved' if r['OUTCOME_SUCCESS_FLAG'] else 'Closed - Unresolved') if r['REFERRAL_STATUS'].startswith('Closed') else r['REFERRAL_STATUS']

post.name: OUTCOME_REASON
post.expr: 'Client Received Services' if r['OUTCOME_SUCCESS_FLAG'] else weighted({'Unable to Contact Client': 40 * (0.4 if r['NEW_PARTNER_EFFECT'] else 1), 'Client Declined': 18, 'Not Eligible': 14, 'Outside Service Area': 8, 'Program at Capacity': 20 * (3 if r['SERVICE_TYPE'] == 'Housing & Shelter' and r['COUNTY'] == 'Maricopa' and ramp(200) > 0 else 1)}) if r['REFERRAL_STATUS'] in ('Closed - Unresolved','Declined','Auto-Recalled','Recalled') else 'In Progress'

post.name: ACCEPTED_FLAG
post.expr: 1 if r['REFERRAL_STATUS'] in ('Accepted','In Progress','Closed - Resolved','Closed - Unresolved') else 0

post.name: DAYS_TO_RESOLVE
post.expr: round(r['DAYS_TO_ACCEPT'] + lognorm({'Food Assistance': 3, 'Transportation': 3, 'Utilities': 8, 'Housing & Shelter': 21, 'Income Support': 10, 'Employment': 24, 'Mental & Behavioral Health': 14, 'Benefits Navigation': 9, 'Individual & Family Support': 12, 'Legal Assistance': 28, 'Clothing & Household Goods': 4}[r['SERVICE_TYPE']] * (0.7 if r['NEW_PARTNER_EFFECT'] else 1), 0.5), 1) if r['CLOSED_FLAG'] else None

post.name: SLA_BREACH_FLAG
post.expr: 1 if (r['REFERRAL_STATUS'] in ('Pending','Auto-Recalled') and age > 2) or (r['DAYS_TO_ACCEPT'] is not None and r['DAYS_TO_ACCEPT'] > 2) else 0

post.name: INVOICE_AMOUNT_USD
post.expr: r['SERVICE_COST_USD'] if r['FUNDING_SOURCE'] == '1115 Medicaid Waiver' and r['RESOLVED_FLAG'] else 0.0

post.name: INVOICE_STATUS
post.expr: 'Not Invoiced' if not r['INVOICE_AMOUNT_USD'] else ('Pending' if age < 20 else weighted({'Paid': 88, 'Approved': 9, 'Rejected': 3}))

post.name: FOLLOW_UP_COUNT
post.expr: rng.randint(0, 2) + (3 if r['OUTCOME_REASON'] == 'Unable to Contact Client' else 0) + (1 if r['URGENCY'] != 'Routine' else 0)
